name: Emergency Crop Assistance Program (synthetic)
summary: Direct payments for crop losses from a declared natural disaster.
description: Disaster assistance payment for producers whose crops were destroyed or damaged by hail, drought, flood, freeze, wind or excessive moisture in a declared disaster county. Covers row crops such as corn, soybeans, wheat and cotton. Payment is based on percent of crop loss and planted acres.
required_documents: Proof of loss (photos or adjuster notes)

name: Livestock, Honeybee and Fish Emergency Relief (synthetic)
summary: Help for livestock, honeybee and farm-raised fish losses from weather.
description: Emergency relief for livestock producers, beekeepers and fish farmers who lost animals, hives or feed because of severe weather, flood, wildfire or blizzard. Covers feed and water hauling costs and grazing losses.
required_documents: Records of feed or water purchases

name: Livestock Forage Disaster Payment (synthetic)
summary: Payments for grazing losses during drought or wildfire.
description: Compensates livestock producers for grazing losses on pasture and rangeland caused by qualifying drought or wildfire on federally managed land.

name: Noninsured Crop Disaster Assistance (synthetic)
summary: Coverage for crops that have no federal crop insurance available.
description: Financial assistance for producers of crops that cannot be covered by federal crop insurance, such as many vegetables, fruits, herbs, hay and specialty crops, when natural disasters cause low yields or prevented planting.
required_documents: Application filed before the coverage deadline

name: FSA Emergency Loan (synthetic)
summary: Low-interest loans to recover from production or physical losses.
description: Emergency loans for farmers and ranchers in a disaster-designated county to restore or replace essential property, pay production costs for the disaster year, pay family living expenses, reorganize the farm or refinance debts after a crop loss of at least 30 percent.
required_documents: Tax returns for the last 3 years

name: FSA Microloan (synthetic)
summary: Small, simple loans for small and beginning farms.
description: Microloans up to $50,000 for small, beginning, niche and urban farms to buy equipment, seed, feed, fencing or cover operating costs. Simplified paperwork for small operations under 200 acres.

name: FSA Direct Operating Loan (synthetic)
summary: Loans for seed, fertilizer, equipment and living expenses.
description: Direct operating loans to buy livestock, seed, fertilizer, equipment and to pay operating and family living expenses for family farms unable to get commercial credit.
required_documents: Tax returns for the last 3 years
Letter of credit denial from a bank

name: Federal Crop Insurance Claim (synthetic)
summary: File a notice of loss on your existing crop insurance policy.
description: If you have a federal crop insurance policy, report crop damage from hail, drought, flood, freeze, wind, excessive moisture, disease or insects to your insurance agent within 72 hours of discovery to start an insurance claim.

name: Tree Assistance Program (synthetic)
summary: Replant or rehabilitate orchard trees, vines and bushes after disaster.
description: Assistance for orchardists and nursery growers to replant or rehabilitate fruit trees, nut trees, vines and bushes lost to natural disaster with tree mortality above 15 percent.

name: Emergency Conservation Program (synthetic)
summary: Repair farmland, fences and water systems damaged by disaster.
description: Cost-share funds to remove debris, restore fences, grade and shape farmland, and repair livestock water and conservation structures damaged by flood, wind, wildfire or drought.

name: Iowa Crop Recovery Grant (synthetic)
summary: State grant for Iowa growers recovering from storm damage.
description: One-time grant for Iowa corn and soybean growers who lost crops to hail, wind or derecho storms. Helps cover replanting, cleanup and lost income.

name: Nebraska Drought Relief Grant (synthetic)
summary: State relief for Nebraska producers hit by drought.
description: Grant for Nebraska crop and livestock producers with drought losses to help buy feed, haul water and cover irrigation costs.

name: Texas Wildfire Recovery Fund (synthetic)
summary: Helps Texas ranchers rebuild after wildfire.
description: Grant for Texas ranchers and farmers to rebuild fences, replace hay and feed, and restore pasture lost to wildfire.

name: California Specialty Crop Resilience Grant (synthetic)
agency: California Department of Food and Agriculture
summary: Grants for California fruit, nut and vegetable growers after disaster.
description: Competitive grant for California specialty crop growers, including fruit, nuts, grapes and vegetables, recovering from drought, fire, freeze or flood.

name: Beginning Farmer Recovery Grant (synthetic)
summary: Grant for farmers in their first 10 years who suffered losses.
description: Support for beginning farmers and ranchers in their first ten years who suffered crop or livestock losses, to rebuild operations and stay in farming.

name: Small Farm Disaster Relief Grant (synthetic)
summary: Grant for small farms under 180 acres hit by disaster.
description: Small family farms under 180 acres with income under $250,000 can get grants to recover from hail, drought, flood, wind or freeze losses.

name: Cover Crop Recovery Incentive (synthetic)
summary: Pays to plant cover crops on fields damaged by flood or erosion.
description: Incentive payments to plant cover crops on cropland damaged by flood, excessive moisture or erosion to rebuild soil health.

name: Hail Damage Replant Assistance (synthetic)
summary: Helps pay for seed to replant fields destroyed by hail.
description: Assistance to buy seed and cover replanting costs when hail destroyed a planted crop early enough in the season to replant.

name: Dairy Disaster Assistance (synthetic)
summary: Relief for dairy farmers who dumped milk or lost cows in a disaster.
description: Payments to dairy operations for milk that was dumped or not produced, and dairy cows lost, because of flood, power loss, blizzard or extreme heat.

name: Organic Farm Loss Support (synthetic)
summary: Helps certified organic farms recover certification costs after loss.
description: Covers organic certification fees and lost organic premium for certified organic farms that lost crops to disaster.

name: Severe Storm Farm Repair Loan (synthetic)
summary: Low-interest loans to repair barns, bins and buildings after storms.
description: Disaster loans to repair or replace barns, grain bins, machine sheds and other farm buildings damaged by wind, tornado, hail or flood.

name: Spring Freeze Fruit Loss Payment (synthetic)
summary: Payments to fruit growers who lost blossoms or crop to late freeze.
description: Payments for fruit and nut growers whose blossoms or crop were killed by a late spring freeze or frost.

name: Plains Wheat Drought Relief (synthetic)
summary: Drought relief for wheat and sorghum growers in the Plains.
description: Aid for wheat, sorghum and barley producers in Kansas, Oklahoma, Nebraska, Colorado and Texas who lost yield to drought.

name: Delta Flood Recovery Program (synthetic)
summary: Flood aid for rice, cotton and soybean farms in the Delta.
description: Assistance for rice, cotton and soybean producers in Arkansas, Mississippi, Louisiana and Missouri whose fields flooded.

name: Farm and Ranch Stress Support (synthetic)
summary: Free counseling and financial planning help after a hard season.
description: Free counseling, financial planning and mental health support for farmers and ranchers facing stress after disaster, debt or crop loss. Open to every farm family.
